paragraphs: - The ScholarPredict project focuses on building an accurate and interpretable ensemble classification model using the Random Forest algorithm to predict the academic performance category of a student.

- The primary objective is to provide timely academic support for students who are likely to perform poorly early in the semester, demonstrating a practical application of educational data mining and machine learning.

- The project uses a suitable dataset containing attributes such as attendance percentage, internal assessment marks, assignment scores, previous semester grades, weekly study hours, and participation in extracurricular activities.
- The model is trained using Random Forest classifier to identify students who are likely to perform poorly early in the semester.
